messages:
IncidentBot: Pager: SEV2 - elevated 5xx rate for service=redwood-runtime-eu (error_type=502). See alert: https://pager.example/INC-202812 :rotating_light:
Alex: saw it. i'm on metrics. looks like spike started 11:17 UTC.
Ravi: oncall here. checking logs and node health.
Jamie: infra check: ASG scale didn't spin up. nodes stuck in Pending -> AttachVolume step. suspect AWS API rate limit.
MonitoringBot: Auto-remediation attempted: increased replica count to 18 but pods pending due to attach errors.
Elia: security note: if we need to repro, preserve node consoles. possible gap in audit-forwarder between 11:19-11:25 UTC — flagged.
Alex: mitigation plan: 1) failover customer traffic to lwm region 2) reduce concurrency per-worker to lower memory pressure 3) enable model-fallback for low-priority routes.
Ravi: executing steps. routing update: ```curl -XPOST https://proxy.internal/route -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","dest":"eu-lwm"}'```
Jamie: increasing worker throttles: updating configmap `inference-config` -> `max_concurrency: 8`. applying: ```kubectl apply -f cm.yaml```. also spinning a small nodepool in another AZ to avoid attach bottleneck.
Michelle: CS: notified two enterprise customers (Globex, MapleFin). tickets CS-2509, CS-2510 opened.
Elia: Audit-forwarder restart trace: saw a restart at 11:20:12 UTC with SIGKILL and no graceful flush. likely dropped buffer.
Ravi: errors in main service down from 22% -> 4% after routing. good. keep monitoring.
Alex: Incident acknowledged. Incident ID: INC-202812. Severity SEV2.
Jamie: infra action: create INF-7921 to hunt attach issue & ASG policy tuning. assigning to @jamie. ETA 5d.
Elia: immediate compliance actions to collect evidence: 1) export CloudTrail for 11:00-11:40 UTC 2) pull audit-forwarder pod logs and node journalctl 3) snapshot EBS volumes for any nodes that may contain ephemeral logs 4) place artifacts in secure bucket `incident-evidence/INC-202812`.
Michelle: legal asked for chain-of-custody. i'll open COMPL-519 and loop Legal.
Alex: propose postmortem meeting Thu 2026-07-23 15:00 UTC. agenda attached in doc: timeline, infra root cause, forwarder loss, customer impact, remediation, compliance evidence. https://docs.redwood/postmortems/INC-202812
Ravi: i'll run the postmortem. Elia, can you lead the compliance evidence section?
Elia: yes. immediate note: there's a 6-minute gap in forwarded audit events (approx 11:19:58 - 11:25:58 UTC). we must attempt to reconstruct from host logs and CloudTrail first. if not available, produce an evidence attestation.
Jamie: infra commands to snapshot volumes: ```for vol in $(aws ec2 describe-instances --filters "Name=tag:inc,Values=INC-202812" --query 'Reservations[].Instances[].BlockDeviceMappings[].Ebs.VolumeId' --output text); do aws ec2 create-snapshot --volume-id $vol --description "INC-202812"; done```
Alex: CloudWatch export example: ```aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /redwood/audit-forwarder --start-time 1802466600000 --end-time 1802467950000 > audit-window.json``` (timestamps in ms).
Elia: upload with encryption and restricted ACL: ```aws s3 cp audit-window.json s3://incident-evidence/INC-202812/audit-window.json --sse aws:kms --acl bucket-owner-full-control``` record sha256.
Michelle: action items from thread: 
- A1: Postmortem doc (owner=Ravi) due 2026-07-25. add timeline & links.
- A2: Infra (owner=Jamie) INF-7921: fix ASG attach retry/backoff, add AZ-spread for node pools. due 2026-07-30.
- A3: Forwarder hardening (owner=Elia) increase forwarder memory, add checkpointing to durable store, add restart alerts. due 2026-07-28.
- A4: Evidence bundle (owner=Elia) collect CloudTrail, node journals, forwarder logs, snapshot IDs, upload to S3 and record hashes (COMPL-519). due 2026-07-22.
- A5: Customer comms (owner=Michelle) certified post-incident notice & compliance note to affected customers. due 2026-07-22.
Ravi: adding tasks to tracker now. pinning logs to doc.
Elia: note for compliance: if missing audit events cannot be recovered, we'll prepare a signed attestation and include mitigations and detection improvements.
Michelle: Legal engaged on COMPL-519. requesting retention 90 days and restricted access to sec/legal/oncall only.
Jamie: we'll add a synthetic heartbeat metric from forwarder and an alert if heartbeat misses 1m.
MonitoringBot: Incident INC-202812 moved to mitigated -> monitoring.
Alex: handoff: I'm handing monitoring to Ravi-nextshift. please page primary on any regression.
Ravi: accepted. will monitor dashboards for 12h. thanks team.
Elia: starting evidence collection now, will post S3 object hashes here when complete.
Michelle: will draft customer letters and send after Legal sign-off.
Ravi: closing this thread — full postmortem to be recorded and shared in #incidents. :white_check_mark:
